whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a go.mod that names no toolchain, so the local one decides.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a go.mod that names no toolchain, so the local one decides.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm go.mod no longer carries a go.mod that names no toolchain, so the local one decides.
